text:
alex: FYI canary in eu-west is flapping after today's deploy, observed 502s and 5xx on the ingress path check
maria: Saw deploy-bot alert. Which overlay landed?
deploy-bot: [alert] Canary failure: myservice v3.2.1-canary (eu-west). Health probe 6/15 failures in 2m. Release annotations: overlay-merge: true, initiated-by: ci-pipeline
jordan: Do we have the merged values diff?
alex: Pasting the merged snippet from deploy logs:
```diff
@@ ingress:
-  enabled: false
+  enabled: true
+  path: /internal/api
+  rewrite: true
```
maria: Whoa path/rewrite looks like the staging overlay. That should never be in prod. Likely a merge-time mis-tag.
sam: Chart version stayed on 3.2.1-canary but image tag was stable. So this is values-only. We can either rollback release or patch values. Change window open for ~25m.
prod-oncall: Rolling back will revert a security label change included in the chart bump. Prefer values-only patch to preserve chart fixes.
jordan: Agreed. Patch values -> hotfix release (3.2.1-valuesfix) and pin the canary in eu-west while we validate. Low blast radius.
maria: I'll prepare a hotfix values file removing ingress.path and rewrite, and promote as values-only. Command I'll run:
```bash
helm upgrade --install myservice ./charts/myservice -f values.yaml -f hotfix-values.yaml --namespace prod --set deployer=hotfix-bot
kubectl rollout status deploy/myservice -n prod --watch --timeout=120s
```
alex: Add an annotation to the release notes: "fix(values): remove staging ingress keys accidentally merged into prod overlay". Also file a short postmortem note.
sam: I'll add a deploy-bot preflight rule to reject overlays containing ingress.rewrite or overlays named "staging" when target is prod. I'll open PR #4310.
deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @maria: pin release for myservice in eu-west to chart 3.2.0 until validation complete. Automated rollback skipped.
maria: Hotfix pushed -> 3.2.1-valuesfix. Pods healthy, 200 responses on smoke checks. K8s events show quick restart and no crashloops.
prod-oncall: Nice. Keep canary pinned for 20m and run smoke + basic e2e. I'll monitor metrics.
jordan: After validation, unpin and promote. Sam, can you also add a unit test to the overlay-merge tool to ensure overlay names don't cross-target environments?
sam: Yup adding test + PR comment. PR #4310 includes test and schema rule.
alex: Note for release notes: add link to PR #4310 and brief cause/action. Also add a reminder to run overlay-lint before merging.
maria: TL;DR: values-only hotfix applied, canary pinned, follow-ups: deploy-bot preflight + overlay-lint in CI + release note blurb. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Pin cleared by @prod-oncall after validation window. (automated)
